entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: It's not true that the Phantom[n]Thieves' leader died, right!?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: There's no way the Phantom[n]Thieves could be defeated!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I was really worried! I thought[n]I'd never see you again...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Man, it's such a relief[n]to hear things are OK.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Well, if you need anything,[n]I'll be at the arcade.
